title: PhoneDash
blurb: Turns an old Android phone into a bedside or desk display: swipeable screens of tiles for weather, timers, media controls and device stats, with scheduled dimming. No accounts or tracking.

title: AstraScan
blurb: Walk an Orbbec Astra Pro around an object or a room and get a colored 3D mesh out. Live tracking, loop closure, a background build queue, and STL/OBJ/GLB export for printing.

title: HueHuhWhat
blurb: Android app that helps color-blind people name colors: point the camera, read the color in large text or hear it spoken. Pin extra points, freeze a frame; everything runs on-device.

title: ResistOR
blurb: Reads resistor values from their color bands, in a photo or a live camera feed. Finds every resistor in view, even on a breadboard, and locks a reading once frames agree.

title: YDL
blurb: Desktop front end for yt-dlp: paste a link, preview it, and save it as MP4 or as M4A/MP3/Opus/WAV audio. Has a queue, history, playlists, and a smaller Lite build.

title: STATIC
blurb: Canvas field, scroll theater, Web Audio. The first prototype parked here, now living in its own repo.

title: Awaiting payload
blurb: Mentally reserved for the next half-baked idea that needs a public URL.
